# NexusFlo24

> AI-powered sales & marketing automation platform. Capture leads, nurture them across Email, WhatsApp and SMS, and convert with AI funnels and a built-in CRM.

NexusFlo24 helps creators, entrepreneurs and small businesses turn website visitors into paying customers automatically — no tech skills needed.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and hero pitch.
- [Features](/features): Full feature list — CRM, automations, funnels, multi-channel messaging, AI copy, analytics.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans (Starter, Plus, Pro, Enterprise), credit packs and 14-day free trial details.
- [About](/about): Company story, mission and team.
- [Contact](/contact): Sales and support contact form.
- [Academy](/academy): Free training resources on marketing automation.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on AI sales, marketing automation and growth.
- [Referral](/referral): Refer-a-friend program (500 credits per signup).

## How it works

- [Capture](/how-it-works/capture): Lead capture via forms, funnels and integrations.
- [Nurture](/how-it-works/nurture): Multi-channel automated follow-ups.
- [Convert](/how-it-works/convert): Closing leads with AI sales workflows and bookings.
